prompt.project_info: Create a realistic smartphone mirror selfie in a bright domestic room with warm golden-hour light.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with very long dark-brown wavy hair, warm natural skin, and a confident playful expression, wearing a fully buttoned white long-sleeved shirt, opaque metallic-grey knee-length skirt, and opaque black tights with black shoes.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body mirror reflection, phone visible in hand, comfortable standing or seated pose angled slightly left, white rug, fiddle-leaf plant, round black-and-white cushions, blue LED strip, and light grey flooring.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden-hour sunlight from the left creates crisp plant-leaf shadows, mixed with cooler room shadows; casual influencer selfie atmosphere without suggestive posing.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-end smartphone mirror photography, full-body framing, realistic skin, hair, fabric texture, natural grain, dynamic range, and sharp reflection.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An approved adult woman with very long dark brown wavy hair takes a realistic mirror selfie in a bright domestic room. She wears a fully buttoned white long-sleeved shirt, an opaque metallic-grey knee-length skirt, opaque black tights, and black shoes. She stands or sits comfortably angled slightly to the left with a playful confident expression while holding a pink smartphone. The reflection shows a large vertical mirror, white rug, tall fiddle-leaf plant, round black-and-white cushions, blue LED strip, white walls, and light grey wood-laminate flooring. Warm golden-hour sunlight enters from the left and creates distinct plant shadows, mixed with cooler ambient room light. High-fidelity natural smartphone photography with real skin, hair, fabric texture, grain, and dynamic range.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, unbuttoned shirt, bra visibility, exposed midriff, mini skirt, sheer stockings, all-fours pose, arched-back pose, thirst-trap styling, sexualized expression, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.
